name: Louise Espinoza
source: Louise and Lena met at college, and they became good friends. She moved to the city to study and didn't know too many people, so she was glad to find someone she could get along with since she's not the most out-going person. In fact, she tends to be moody, and she always has some drama going on, especially with guys. She has a complicated character, but once you get to know her, she's a nice, sensitive girl and a loyal friend.
